contracts_rationale: Docs-toolchain and diagram mission: it defines no interface of its own and reads the existing charter contract without changing it (C-001).
friendly_name: Docsite on DocKitty 0.6.0 and pack-ecosystem diagrams
purpose_context: The docsite still builds on DocKitty 0.5.0 although 0.6.0 (API reference pages from OpenAPI files, schema pages) shipped on 2026-11-02, and the PlantUML architecture diagrams still draw the pack model that ADR-0048 to ADR-0052 (accepted 2026-11-02) change. Readers should see current tooling and diagrams that match the decided pack ecosystem.
purpose_tldr: Move the docsite to DocKitty 0.6.0 and redraw the architecture diagrams for the accepted pack-ecosystem decisions.
